item.subject: science
item.stem:
Priya wants to measure the length of the curved edge of a round steel plate in her kitchen. She has only a straight metre scale and a piece of thread.
Which method will give the correct length of the curved edge?

options.A: Measure the straight distance between the two ends of the curved edge with the metre scale.
options.B: Lay the thread along the curved edge, then straighten the thread and measure its length with the metre scale.
options.C: Estimate the length by eye, because a curve cannot be measured.
options.D: Measure the diameter of the plate and take that as the length of the curved edge.
